title: A thicker elastic wire
hook: Change cross-sectional area and predict extension.
misconception: extension doubles when cross-sectional area doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply ΔL = FL/(AY) to compare extension when cross-sectional area changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a uniform wire under fixed tension length and Young modulus in the linear regime, ΔL = FL/(AY). When cross-sectional area doubles, extension becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model ΔL = FL/(AY); scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a uniform wire under fixed tension length and Young modulus in the linear regime, with a nonzero initial result. If cross-sectional area triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on extension?
recall.why: Apply ΔL = FL/(AY) under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
